_source: Princeton Engineering Events: September 7 - September 14, 2026.html, a Mailchimp export of the live newsletter, transcribed by hand.
_why: The simulator exists to predict what this edition would contain. Checking it against a real one is the only way to know whether it does. Transcribed rather than parsed because the export is 34 nested layout tables and a multi-line sponsor list defeats any cheap parser -- which is itself why the editors want this generated.

_edition.note: The title the editors wrote spans Mon 7th to Mon 14th, which is a human label rather than the coverage window. Publication shifted to Tuesday the 8th for Labor Day, so our weekly rule needs the publication date overridden to reproduce it.

expect.why: This was the one event no configuration of the simulator could produce: Data and Intelligent Systems published no feed we had registered. Registering `dais` for the DaIS newsletter closed it, and it declares `engineering-newsletter` too -- the evidence being this entry, with that sponsor, in this edition. The location differs: the editor wrote `Maeder Hall, Room 002` and the feed says `Maeder Hall, 002 Auditorium`, which is left unsplit because `002 Auditorium` is not room-shaped.
